title: Terminology definitions for stakeholders + lawyers — certification / verification / signing / watermarking
description:
## BLUF

Define the four terms precisely for lawyers/stakeholders: **certification** (umbrella = attestation + signing + optional watermarking — BM-1), **verification** (configurable workflow; a public, repeatable read — BM-2 + the PS-556 resolution), **signing** (ambiguous — Phil is researching external labels), **watermarking** (optional element; applying it creates a new version → mandatory re-certification).

## Naming (Kam's call, same meeting)

Externally the team may say "Legacy UAT" (S) / "Blockchain Manager" (K); **internally we KEEP S and K — do not rename anything.**

Source: 2026-08-11 technical weekly (Stuart, Phil, Kam).
